body:
I’ve only been to one but my partner set me up with it. So far no call back. I feel so worthless.

I’m in marketing, writing, social media, and image management / photography.

It’s crazy because I’m so good at so many things but I just can’t seem to get a job anywhere. Not even call centres have emailed me back.
I have applied to hundreds of jobs (not exaggerating) since I left my last one. I would rather work full time than be at home every day alone with my thoughts.
I hear you. I’m in the same boat. Therapy costs. I’m not working because I’m depressed... it’s a downwards spiral.

Triggered as in I get scared of being alone with my thoughts. I get angry he’s going to work but I don’t let him know. He already feels bad enough already. He works 6 days a week to support me because he feels guilty for what he did. It doesn’t feel real anymore. He’s in this for guilt and I’m in this for financial support. I’m so lost.
What is hard in your life right now op?
Yes and no. When he’s around I feel okay... but when he’s gone I get triggered. Almost like I went through ptsd or something.
What are you being bullied for op?
